title: Compact reader rendering of defaults; add 'root-cause' default
summary: Change DefaultsModel::render so the reader sees only the first sentence of each statement, keeping full statements for producer/verifier briefs. Add a multi-sentence 'root-cause' entry to defaults.toml and leave every existing statement byte-for-byte unchanged; note the compact rendering in the CHANGELOG.

defaults_applied.how: Compact rendering is implemented in Rust in athena-data.
Add unit tests for render; cargo test and clippy must pass.
One focused change: compact render plus the single new entry.
Token budget test enforces the reader's size limit.
Verifier compares defaults.toml diff and runs cargo checks.
CHANGELOG and doc comments written for an outside reader.
No secrets or personal data in the change.

assumptions: 'Compact' means first sentence of each statement, split on '. ' or terminal period, so single-sentence statements render unchanged.
The edited design doc is docs/design/athena-v0.md (the verifier's nit), if a design edit is made at all.
The earlier candidate reached 1723 of 1800 tokens; leaving existing statements whole adds about 40 tokens (estimate), still under budget.
Sentence splitting must not break on abbreviations like 'e.g.'; the root-cause statement is worded to avoid them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every existing default in defaults.toml (rust, strangers, evidence, buy-first, tested, public, small, verified, designed, lazy-requests, mechanism) has its statement, applies_to and source byte-identical to the base commit (git diff shows only added lines for the new entry).

defaults.toml gains a 'root-cause' entry: fix where the fault originates, not the symptom or the one instance that surfaced; name an out-of-scope cause and propose the fix rather than working around it; the change description names the root cause and why the change addresses it; the root-cause fix is the one focused change ('small'). Source cites BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-13: Root causes'. Its first sentence alone conveys the core rule.
No new defaults.toml field is introduced (the installed gate still parses the file), and BRIEF.md and the token budgets in athena.toml are unchanged.

DefaultsModel::render (reader form) emits only the first sentence of each statement; full statements remain available to the producer/verifier briefs via get(). Statements containing ';' or ', and' remain whole in the reader form because they are one sentence.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry that adds the 'root-cause' default and mentions the compact reader rendering.

Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: all pass, including a new unit test that render() shows only the first sentence of a multi-sentence statement, keeps a semicolon statement whole, and that the reader's defaults component is within its token budget in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs.

out_of_scope: Raising token budgets or editing athena.toml
departures: Slightly higher verification risk than usual because the prior attempt failed on a subtle meaning-cut; slightly lower accepted probability is not warranted since the request is explicit.
